scope: Only the local codegen-parity snapshots and this commit; no secret values are recorded or rewritten.

excludedSnapshots.reason: Known high-entropy configuration secret; do not read or include its payload.
Sensitive-reference match not fully classified; conservatively excluded without changing fixed bytes.

commonConsumptionStableRecord.meaning: Exact copy of the bounded artifact-fingerprint/public-signature observation; no JAR, POM payload, runtime logs or credentials.

referencePolicy: A fixed local snapshot index does not mean every indexed payload is delivered in Git. Missing excluded bytes must be BLOCKED when required; never infer or fabricate them from their hash.
